channel.title: AI Daily News
channel.description: Daily curated AI news, 10 articles max. Curated, credible, traceable.

item.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
item.description: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.

item.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
item.description: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.

item.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
item.description: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.

item.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
item.description: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests.

item.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro
item.description: GPT‑5.6 is now available in Kiro, helping developers plan, build, review, and test software with better price-performance.

item.title: Introducing AI Futures
item.description: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

item.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
item.description: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

item.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
item.description: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

item.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
item.description: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

item.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
item.description: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.
